themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, embedding them in budget negotiations and coalition agreements. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize preferential treatment for citizens over immigrants in housing, social services, and employment, often framed as a defense against 'electoral fraud' or 'mass naturalizations.'

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia and Valencia budgets, threatening to block investitures without concessions. Proposes 115 amendments to prioritize Spanish citizens in social services and housing.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government promotes language programs for Italian students abroad, implicitly prioritizing national identity. Vannacci's faction pushes for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes €40B 'climate plan' with air conditioning in schools/hospitals, framed as a national priority for French citizens. Criticizes government for 'manufacturing voters' via immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Magyar's government rejects EU proposals to deny temporary protection to Ukrainian men fleeing conscription, citing protection for Transcarpathian Hungarians as a national priority.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's party scraps 'woke' diversity schemes in Staffordshire, replacing them with merit-based policies. Proposes asylum seekers repay £10,000 for accommodation to deter illegal migration.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni amid corruption allegations has triggered a cross-national ripple effect, with right-wing leaders in Italy and the U.S. using the scandal to critique 'libertarian' governance. The crisis has exposed fractures in Milei's coalition and prompted a cabinet reshuffle, with transnational media framing it as a cautionary tale about far-right economic policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni resigns after scandal over undeclared assets and illicit enrichment. Milei replaces him with Diego Santilli, sparking internal conflicts and legislative paralysis.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. media and Trump allies use Adorni's scandal to criticize Milei's 'libertarian experiment,' linking it to broader concerns about far-right governance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media highlights Adorni's resignation as a failure of Milei's 'radical libertarianism,' with Meloni distancing herself from the controversy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right uses Adorni's scandal to attack Milei's government, framing it as evidence of corruption in libertarian administrations.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe are escalating attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, using legislative amendments, public debates, and symbolic gestures to roll back protections. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to frame LGBTQ+ policies as 'ideological' or 'foreign,' with transnational networks amplifying these narratives through protests and media campaigns.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Rejects LGBTQ+ flags in public spaces, blocks Pride-related motions, and proposes amendments to defund trans healthcare. Accuses left-wing parties of 'imposing gender ideology.'

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces criticism for cutting funds to protected areas and opposing LGBTQ+ visibility. Vannacci's faction attacks 'gender ideology' in schools.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes LGBTQ+ policies in overseas territories, framing them as 'woke' impositions. Criticizes government for 'prioritizing minorities over French citizens.'

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Scraps LGBTQ+ staff networks in Staffordshire, calling them 'woke.' Councillors single out trans employees, sparking backlash.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Magyar's government faces criticism for exploiting LGBTQ+ issues in political debates, with opposition accusing it of 'far-right tactics.'

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD faces a constitutional crisis as intelligence reports link its growth to rising right-wing extremism. The party's potential ban, internal power struggles, and electoral successes are being closely watched by far-right parties across Europe, with transnational networks debating the implications of its rise for democratic institutions.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Intelligence reports estimate 28,000 AfD members are extremists. Party faces potential ban, internal power struggles, and electoral successes in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French far-right monitors AfD's crisis, with Le Pen's eligibility for 2027 elections uncertain. RN strategizes to avoid similar legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media debates AfD's rise, with Meloni's government distancing itself from extremist factions. Vannacci's faction draws parallels to AfD's rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's party faces scrutiny over extremist ties, with internal debates about AfD's influence on UK politics. Nigel Farage's £5M donation scandal mirrors AfD's funding controversies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right uses AfD's crisis to justify its own hardline policies, framing opposition to extremism as 'leftist censorship.'

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical narratives
themes.blurb: Poland and Ukraine are locked in a diplomatic standoff over historical narratives, with Poland threatening to block Ukraine's EU accession and revoking honors for Zelensky. This theme reflects a broader far-right push to weaponize historical grievances, with transnational networks amplifying these tensions to undermine Ukraine's international standing.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. media amplifies Poland-Ukraine tensions, framing them as a failure of Biden's Ukraine policy. Trump allies use the dispute to criticize NATO unity.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian government uses Poland-Ukraine tensions to justify its own opposition to Ukraine's EU accession, citing 'historical grievances.'

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's party frames Poland-Ukraine tensions as evidence of 'EU overreach,' calling for stricter immigration controls.
